QuestInfo.name: [6th Job] An Erda That Didn't Exist Before
QuestInfo.0: #rErdas#k have appeared at the Barrier Between Worlds, and your attacks don't work on the #rErdas#k... In the midst of the Erdas threat, Elwin has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.2: Erdas combined on the spot where the #runfamiliar Erdas#k were defeated, and #r#o8645392##k appeared. After the battle, a large Erda fell towards you, and swept you into a torrent.
QuestInfo.1: On the spots where the #runfamiliar Erdas#k were defeated, the Erdas combined to form a new monster. Defeat the #r#o8645392##k that appeared and make it out of this crisis alive.
